text: The Thunderbird merge, reference and test-task loaders accept the sixth write_artifacts argument and pass it to the nested loaders they invoke. Merge preserves reference tasks before local transformed tasks; reference forwards the argument to its dynamically selected loader. This is an interface capability pass-through, not an artifact write at these call sites. The later follow-up only wraps a call and reorders one browser-test manifest entry. No task graph, artifact or test ran.
title: Thunderbird taskgraph wrappers forward write_artifacts to nested loaders
